updates.detailed_summary_zh:
BounceBit 将退役其独立 Layer 1，并基于 8 月 19 日的快照在 BNB Chain 上按 1:1 比例重新发行 BB 代币。此前一个授权漏洞导致约 2.865 亿枚 BB 从九个账户被转走。新代币的 gas、质押、奖励和治理功能尚未定义。

这一事件表明，协议级漏洞可能迫使链关闭，使代币持有人在迁移期间面临代币用途不明的情况。它也凸显了从 Evmos 等堆栈继承代码的风险，以及跨网络迁移时保留代币价值的难度。

快照截止点为 8 月 19 日 21:02:35 UTC 的区块 20,697,260；低于 10 BB 的余额将通过后续领取门户处理。新的 BEP-20 合约已部署，但为配合交易所尽职调查暂不公布地址，旧链不会重启。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
BounceBit is retiring its standalone Layer 1 and will reissue BB tokens 1:1 on BNB Chain based on an Aug. 19 snapshot, after an authorization flaw enabled the movement of about 286.5 million BB from nine accounts. The new token's gas, staking, rewards, and governance roles have not yet been defined.

This incident shows how protocol-level flaws can force a chain to shut down, leaving token holders exposed to undefined token utility during migration. It also highlights the risks of inherited code from stacks like Evmos and the difficulty of preserving token value across network transitions.

The cutoff is block 20,697,260 at 21:02:35 UTC on Aug. 19; balances below 10 BB will be handled via a later claim portal. The new BEP-20 contract is deployed but its address is withheld until exchange due diligence completes, and the old chain will not be restarted.
